token.title: 🔑 Token-ka GitHub
token.intro: GitHub wuxuu saacaddii ka jawaabaa 60 codsi ciwaan aan token soo dirin. Geed fork oo dhammaystiran wuxuu qaataa qiyaastii 32, sidaa darteed booqashada labaad way engegtaa. Token wuxuu xadka u kordhiyaa 5000 saacaddii.
token.step1: Fur Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, kadibna Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: akoonkaaga. Expiration: taariikh kasta, geedku uma baahna wax muddo dheer socda.
token.step4: Ha taabanin ogolaansho kasta. Xogta sharraxa kaydadka dadweynaha midna uma baahna.
token.step5: Samee, kadibna koobiyee qiimaha {token}. GitHub wuxuu muujiyaa hal mar oo keliya.
token.classic: Token caadi ah sidoo kale wuu shaqeeyaa: samee mid aan baaxad la calaamadin. Baaxad madhan weli waxay akhrisaa xogta dadweynaha heerka la xaqiijiyay.
token.stays: Wuxuu ku jiraa browser-kan hoostiisa furaha {key} wuxuuna u socdaa {host} oo keliya. Weligii laguma qoro bar-ka ciwaanka, sidaa darteed xidhiidh aad wadaagto wuxuu sidaa muuqaalka ee ma aha aqoonsiga. Badhanka ka hooseeya goobta ayaa mar kale tirtira isaga iyo kaydka ku-meel-gaarka ah.
token.persistHow: Token-ka geli faylka {env} ee server-ka martigeliya boggan, agtiisa {port}:
token.proxy: oo ku bilow {make}. Kontaynarku wuxuu markaas qoraa qayb nginx ah oo madaxa {header} ku lifaaqa proxy {path} ah, sidaa darteed browser-ku wuxuu wacaa asalkiisa oo weligii ma helo token-ka. Goobtani way baabba'daa, booqde kastana wuxuu wadaagaa hal miisaaniyad oo ah 5000 saacaddii.
fork.refused404: Xariiqyo laamo ah ma jiraan: {message}. 404 halkan waa ama laan aan jirin ama waddo aan proxy-ga server-ku qaadin; shabakadda fork-yada ee sare si kastaba way dhammaystiran tahay.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub codsiyadii saacaddan way ka dhammaadeen, sidaa darteed xariiq laan ah lama sawiri karin. Shabakadda fork-yada ee sare way dhammaystiran tahay. Token ku dar guddiga sifaynta, ama xariiqyada laamaha ka dami guddiga naqshadda si miisaaniyadda loogu isticmaalo shabakadda oo keliya.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub wuxuu ku jawaabay {status} taariikhda gudbinnada, sidaa darteed xariiq laan ah lama sawiri karin. Shabakadda fork-yada ee sare way dhammaystiran tahay.
